summary: Genius Group Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing that NYSE Regulation halted trading in its ordinary shares on November 10, 2026 due to an abnormally low trading price. The company is implementing a 1-for-10 share consolidation, expected effective 12:01 a.m. Eastern on November 20, 2026, with trading to resume split-adjusted that morning under existing symbol GNS. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or ownership terms are stated. A new CUSIP will be announced separately. What to watch: whether the consolidation restores NYSE American minimum-price compliance and prevents a delisting proceeding.
